ruleContent.content:
<js>
var out = '';
try {
    // 抛弃正则，直接用字符串分割，完美避开嵌套大括号被截断的问题
    var parts = String(result).split('var player_aaaa=');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
        // 截取到 </script> 之前的内容
        var jsonStr = parts[1].split('</script>')[0].trim();
        // 如果末尾有分号，则去掉分号，确保是纯净的 JSON
        if (jsonStr.charAt(jsonStr.length - 1) === ';') {
            jsonStr = jsonStr.slice(0, -1);
        }
        
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        var url = String(data.url);
        
        if (data.encrypt == 2) {
            var b64Str = String(java.base64Decode(url));
            url = decodeURIComponent(b64Str);
        } else if (data.encrypt == 1) {
            url = decodeURIComponent(url);
        }
        
        out = '' + url.replace(/\\\//g, '/');
    } else {
        out = '⚠️ 解析失败，源码中未找到 player_aaaa 配置。';
    }
} catch(e) {
    out = '⚠️ 解析异常：' + String(e);
}
out;
</js>

(function(){
    var html = String(result);
    var idx = html.indexOf("player_aaaa");
    if (idx < 0) return "";
    var start = html.indexOf("{", idx);
    if (start < 0) return "";
    var depth = 0;
    var end = start;
    for (var i = start; i < html.length; i++) {
        if (html.charAt(i) === "{") depth++;
        else if (html.charAt(i) === "}") {
            depth--;
            if (depth === 0) {
                end = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    var jsonStr = html.substring(start, end + 1);
    try {
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        return data.url || "";
    } catch(e) {
        return "";
    }
})()
</js>
